items.source: By default, Spring will search for an associated scheduler definition: either a unique TaskScheduler bean in the context, or a TaskScheduler bean named "taskScheduler" otherwise; the same lookup will also be performed for a ScheduledExecutorService bean. If neither of the two is resolvable, a local single-threaded default scheduler will be created and used within the registrar.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring 将搜索关联的调度器定义：即在上下文中唯一的 TaskScheduler Bean，或者如果没有找到，则查找名为 "taskScheduler" 的 TaskScheduler Bean；同样也会执行一次查找以获取 ScheduledExecutorService Bean。如果上述两个 Bean 均无法解析，则将在注册器中创建一个本地单线程默认调度器并使用它。

items.source: The examples are equivalent save that in XML a fixed-rate period is used instead of a custom Trigger implementation; this is because the task: namespace scheduled cannot easily expose such support. This is but one demonstration how the code-based approach allows for maximum configurability through direct access to the actual component.
items.translation: 这些示例是等效的，区别在于 XML 使用了一个固定利率周期，而不是自定义的Trigger实现；这是因为task:命名空间的scheduled无法轻易地提供此类支持。这仅仅是基于代码的方法如何通过直接访问实际组件来实现最大配置灵活性的一个演示。

items.source: Note: @EnableScheduling applies to its local application context only, allowing for selective scheduling of beans at different levels. Please redeclare @EnableScheduling in each individual context, for example, the common root web application context and any separate DispatcherServlet application contexts, if you need to apply its behavior at multiple levels.
items.translation: 注意：@EnableScheduling 仅适用于其本地应用程序上下文，从而允许在不同级别选择性地调度 Bean。 如果您需要在多个级别应用其行为，请在每个单独的上下文中重新声明@EnableScheduling，例如公共根 Web 应用程序上下文和任何单独的 DispatcherServlet 应用程序上下文。
